annotations.coverageReview: Visible front and side survey images and corrected four-patch overlays inspected. Moon Serpent has one head. Initial picks on the throat and long whisker were rejected. Final upper-face, snout, lower lip and side cheek/jaw joint patches cover blue facial anatomy rather than the white whiskers or belly. Whiskers, horns and body still require complete animation review.

review.name: Moon Serpent
findings: All 13 source clips actually inspected in 12 enlarged face/body front/side slices. Lower snout/cheek moves relative to upper head, most visible in raised strike and turned defeat. Long whiskers flex as accessories and must remain free. Limbs, body and tail remain connected in raw clips; actual techniques pending. The corresponding battle face/body slices were also actually inspected; the same facial problem is present and there are no additional detached body surfaces in these raw clips. Equipped-technique review remains open.

sourceVisualFirstPass.finding: All 12 source candidate face/body slices actually inspected. Lower lip and cheek now move with the upper skull through raised strike and turned defeat; long white whisker flex and body/tail motion are preserved. Actual equipped techniques remain pending.

review.finalRuntimeFinding: Previous face-only raw/runtime review is superseded by the actual technique leg failure. The supported-body candidate has only the explicitly recorded preliminary coverage; it is not a final approved or live pet.

supersededFaceOnlyRuntimeReview.finding: All 32 final low/medium source/battle complete face/body slices actually inspected, including defeat/revive and the attack sequence. Snout, jaw, long whiskers, ears, horns, belly, tail and four limbs remain connected. The body rises and tucks as a whole during the strike, then returns to the same stance. All six native companion idle sheets and the 16 atlas frames also actually inspected. Actual equipped-technique visual review remains pending.
supersededFaceOnlyRuntimeReview.reason: Actual equipped technique revealed paw collapse; these inspections do not approve the new supported-body candidate.

supportedActionCandidate.conservation: Only 19 body/support/tail tracks in attack, cast and recoil are rewritten; geometry, skin, bind nodes, textures, head/neck action tracks and all ten other clips remain exact.
supportedActionCandidate.rejectedV1: Oni-style IK body pose generated 30 mesh-stretch warnings and was rejected. The unchanged-clip host-ownership diagnostic retained collapsed feet and was rejected.
supportedActionCandidate.visualFinding: All 36 actual technique sheets and 12 enlarged source all-clip face/body slices actually inspected, plus eight four-angle Earth Strike sheets. The corrected support stance eliminates rear-paw collapse and tail-floor clipping while preserving authored head/neck actions and idle tail articulation. Source geometry and independent face checks pass. Final derivative/runtime reviews still required.
supportedActionCandidate.finalVisualFinding: All 24 final source/battle face/body slices, 32 low/medium runtime slices, 36 final battle technique sheets, six fresh companion idle sheets and all 16 atlas cells actually inspected and passed. Existing serpentine glide gait preserved; this repair changes supported attack/cast/recoil stance, not locomotion.

rejectedCoordinatedLegCandidates.required: Independent face/geometry and conservation checks, actual techniques, final source/battle/runtime reviews and rebuilt derivatives before approval.
rejectedCoordinatedLegCandidates.reason: 30 full-geometry stretching warnings in the borrowed IK pose

supersededFailedTechniqueReview.label: independent-legendary-007-techniques-v1
supersededFailedTechniqueReview.finding: Actual equipped Earth Strike side view exposes collapsed/hyperextended rear paws and an isolated white toe behind the tail during windup. The raw/runtime face checks did not detect this joint-orientation defect. Four technique sheets actually inspected; the other eight techniques remain pending.
